== Damage ==
Damage effects are found in the actor file, I have notes on it (c&p'd from a message I got from punk7890).

They're not all the same for each actor but you can take a look around these offsets: These aren't my notes, I think they're Xu's
I don't remember how I found some of mine. Some have something like FFCFFF beside where there damage is done to Link. 00 01 02 03 04 are Fire, ice, normal and knockback (not in that order)

Every thing goes up by 19! (25 normally)
*1= There were more, of it's "attacks" but didn't bother to copy it.
